main_measure.name: t of slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast (pooled, non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with timing > 0; reject if t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 500 non-overlapping cases with non-zero forecast

supporting_check.name: book timing (mean daily gain before costs minus market-rise part)

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and timing is above 0.
reading: The regression uses every grid bar (forecast zero included) with a complete 5-bar return inside its window, the drift is each coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all windows, the book before costs is position held x next-bar coin return averaged over coins per day, and the plan's 'fewer than 500 cases' minimum is applied as 'not observable'.
